name: Park Jae-hyun
bio:
Park Jae-hyun's meticulous approach to composite technology has made him a valuable asset to Reiza Racing Academy. From a young age, he was fascinated by the intricate designs and advanced materials used in motorsport. This passion led him to pursue a degree in mechanical engineering, specializing in composite materials. His dedication and innovative problem-solving skills quickly caught the attention of team scouts, leading to his current role.

Park brings a unique blend of technical expertise and a relentless pursuit of perfection to the team. He is known for his ability to quickly identify and resolve complex issues, ensuring the cars perform at their peak. Park is also a strong advocate for continuous improvement, always seeking out new techniques and technologies to enhance the team's performance. His work ethic is demanding, both on himself and his colleagues, but his commitment to excellence is ultimately what drives the team forward.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part
physical.description: A man of medium build with a focused gaze and a calm demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical drawings and calculations.
Insists on using a specific brand of adhesive tape for all composite repairs.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when concentrating.
